interface.shortDescription: AI visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot & AI Overviews, plus site audits.
interface.longDescription: Ask whether AI assistants actually recommend your business. Website Auditor puts the questions a real customer would ask to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Overviews, reports which businesses get named, and adds security-header, broken-link, performance, and crawlability and markup checks — an overall AI-visibility score (0-100), a per-engine breakdown, competitor comparisons, and ongoing monitoring. Try it before subscribing: the sample report needs no API key and no setup.
defaultPrompt: Show me a sample website audit report
Check whether ChatGPT and other AI assistants recommend my website
Audit my website's AI visibility, security and performance
